caseNameFull: Chapman Kelley v. Chicago Park District

opinions.text:
Motion of Intellectual Property Law Association of Chicago for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted. Motion of Blane De St. Croix, et al. for leave to file a brief as amici curiae granted. Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Seventh Circuit denied.

Same case below, 635 F.3d 290.
